correctness.rationale: Synchronous capacity-2 competitive update with alpha>1 maps every initial {1,2}-configuration exactly to Bernoulli bits after one update. Thereafter a surviving bit has either zero, one or two occupied neighbors, leading to support Y_i=X_i(1-X_{i-1}X_{i+1}) for alpha<=2 and Z_i=X_i(1-X_{i-1})(1-X_{i+1}) for alpha>2. For alpha in (1,2), length-two runs alone oscillate; at equality they freeze at weight one. Window enumeration gives means 3/8 and 1/8, adjacent/distance-2 covariances (-5,1)/64 and (-1,1)/64 respectively, and common exact Var(S_n)=7n/64 for n>=5. A stationary 2-dependent CLT with nonzero asymptotic variance proves Gaussian limits; cyclic boundary error is O(1). Independent exact evolution of 2^n states for n=5..9 with alpha=3/2,2,5/2 (2,976 state/regime cases) reproduced supports and moments. The open-interval odd/even biomass contrast follows Q_n counts with E Q_n=n/16. These are discrete cycles, not continuous LV systems.
